latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the consistency-model-selector skill for distributed systems.

- Provides detailed guidance for selecting the appropriate consistency model (linearizability, causal, eventual) per operation in distributed data systems.
- Helps match operations to replication mechanisms, ordering guarantees, and consensus protocols (Raft, Paxos, ZooKeeper, etcd) as needed.
- Documents per-operation CAP theorem trade-offs, consensus requirements, and failure modes (including 2PC evaluation).
- Requires codebase or architecture document input to analyze operations and their correctness requirements.
- For use by backend engineers, architects, and SREs designing, tuning, or debugging distributed data systems.
